status.critical100.label: Critical 100%
status.critical100.desc: Every attack lands as a critical hit (damage ×2).
status.incomingDamageHalf.label: Damage Taken Halved
status.incomingDamageZero.label: No Damage Taken
status.incomingDamageZero.desc: Attack damage received becomes 0. The unit can still be targeted, wasting the opponent's turn. Damage over time, terrain damage and instant death are not blocked.
status.untargetable.label: Untargetable
status.untargetable.desc: Cannot be chosen as an attack target. Only direct targeting is blocked — area attacks and terrain damage still land.
status.illusionImmune.label: Ward
status.illusionImmune.desc: All illusions are nullified, and exhaustion or disease inflicted by tactics is cleansed. Damage over time from unique skills is not removed.
status.illusionAlways.label: Illusion 100%
status.illusionAlways.desc: Illusions you cast always succeed without resistance. Does not work against 「Ward」.
status.freeMove.label: Free Movement
status.freeMove.desc: Ignores the piece movement mask and moves to any empty square on the map.
status.counterattack.label: Counterattack
status.counterattack.desc: Strikes back at any range when attacked. A counterattack never triggers another counterattack.
status.zeroMpCost.label: MP Cost 0
status.zeroMpCost.desc: Casts tactics and illusions with no MP cost.
status.damageRedirect.label: Damage Shield
status.damageRedirect.desc: Takes attack damage in place of a chosen ally. Damage over time and terrain damage are not redirected.
status.attackAnywhere.label: Ignore Range
status.attackAnywhere.desc: Ignores attack range and strikes any enemy on the map.
status.attackStacking.label: AT Stacking
status.attackStacking.desc: AT rises by 1 with every attack. The stacked amount is lost when the effect ends.
status.instantKillNext.label: Next Attack Slays
status.instantKillNext.desc: The next target attacked is defeated outright.
status.auraIncomingHalf.label: Aura — Allied Damage Halved
status.auraIncomingHalf.desc: Allies within the radius take half damage. The distance is measured again each time damage lands.
status.auraOutgoingHalf.label: Aura — Enemy Attack Halved
status.auraOutgoingHalf.desc: Enemies within the radius deal half damage. The distance is measured again each time damage lands.
status.convertOnHit.label: Three Visits
status.convertOnHit.desc: Marks build up on enemies you strike. At 3 marks you take command of that enemy for the rest of the game.
status.convertProgress.label: Three Visits Mark
status.convertProgress.desc: Marks of 「Three Visits」 are building up. Once full, command is lost — the unit stays in its army but turns on its former allies.
status.deathCurse.label: Dying Stratagem
status.deathCurse.desc: Some time after falling, the marked enemy falls as well.
status.deathMark.label: Dying Stratagem Mark
status.deathMark.desc: Falls some time after Guo Jia falls. Hidden from the other side.
status.outgoingDamageHalf.label: Fear
status.silence.label: Silence
status.dot.label: Damage Over Time
status.dot.desc: HP drops at fixed intervals. What tactics inflicted (exhaustion, disease) is cleansed by 「Ward」, but what a unique skill inflicted is not.
status.mustTarget.label: Forced Target
status.mustTarget.desc: Can only attack the designated opponent.
status.skillSealed.label: Skill Sealed
status.skillSealed.desc: Cannot use its unique skill until the end of the game. A unique skill being cast was cancelled. Cannot be removed.
terrain.fire.label: Fire
terrain.fire.desc: A unit standing on this square loses 1 HP at fixed intervals.
terrain.water.label: Water
terrain.water.desc: Units cannot enter this square. It cannot be used as a path either.
terrain.holy.label: Sanctuary
terrain.holy.desc: A unit standing on this square recovers 1 HP at fixed intervals.
